alex (devex): heads-up — onboarding notes: customers hit two problems: (1) examples that import `require('redwood')` fail in edge samples, (2) types not resolving when bundlers do conditional exports. can we agree on a publish playbook?

maria (pkg-leads): +1, we need a single package surface if possible. my rough plan: publish one tarball with both ESM and CJS artifacts, expose them via conditional `exports` and a stable `types` entry. keeps installs simple for users.

jamal (runtime): runtime constraints: V8/Workers (Cloudflare/Netlify Edge) require ESM; they choke on `require` wrappers and `fs` usage. if our bundle has any dynamic cjs shims it can break. prefer an explicit `exports` path for "./edge" that only contains pure ESM build.

sasha (ts): types are annoying. TypeScript doesn't understand conditional `types` entries per export target. we should publish a single `index.d.ts` at the package root that re-exports specific declarations and use `typesVersions` to help older TS. avoid relying on "\"exports\": { \"types\": ... }" alone.

alex (devex): example package.json snippet that I think covers most cases:
```
{
  "name": "@redwood/sdk",
  "main": "dist/cjs/index.js",
  "module": "dist/esm/index.js",
  "types": "dist/types/index.d.ts",
  "exports": {
    ".": {
      "import": "./dist/esm/index.js",
      "require": "./dist/cjs/index.js",
      "node": {
        "import": "./dist/esm/node.js",
        "require": "./dist/cjs/node.js"
      }
    },
    "./edge": {
      "import": "./dist/esm/edge-index.js"
    }
  }
}
```

maria (pkg-leads): that looks good. addition: ship a tiny `cjs` wrapper that re-exports default exports to support older bundlers (`module.exports = require('./dist/cjs/index.js')`). but keep it minimal — no runtime deps.

jamal (runtime): also enforce build lint that ensures edge bundle is free of `process`, `fs`, `Buffer` references. we had a CI failure last week where a transitive dep pulled in `crypto` polyfills and caused a runtime error on Workers.

ci-bot: CI: redwood-sdk@publish · tests/edge-samples failed on 2026-02-14 16:12:02 — "edge sample import error: Uncaught ReferenceError: require is not defined" — see https://ci.internal/12345

sasha (ts): on typings: two concrete options: 1) publish flattened `dist/types/index.d.ts` that covers both runtime surfaces (edge + node) and add `typesVersions` for older TS to point to `dist/types/ts3.8` if needed; or 2) keep `types` at root and include `types` field inside each exported subpath (but TS support is spotty). i'm leaning to option 1 for simplicity.

alex (devex): what about developer DX in examples? current samples show `const rw = require('@redwood/sdk')` in some and `import rw from '@redwood/sdk'` in others. let's standardize docs to prefer `import` (ESM) for new samples and add a tiny migration note for CJS users.

maria (pkg-leads): publish checklist proposal:
- build: esm edge + esm node + cjs
- types: single flattened d.ts at root (dist/types/index.d.ts)
- package.json: conditional exports + types field
- samples: prefer ESM imports and include a CJS snippet
- CI: edge smoke test that runs built ESM bundle in a Worker-like environment

jamal (runtime): +1, also add an automated test that bundles the edge entry with esbuild/rollup and runs quick runtime verify.

sasha (ts): caution: consumers using `skipLibCheck` will hide some issues; include a small typing smoke test in CI that `tsc --noEmit` against sample app.

alex (devex): outstanding decision: do we keep a separate npm dist-tag for edge-only releases? i prefer no — same version, single tarball, clear exports. any objections?

maria (pkg-leads): no objections. single version simplifies rollbacks and dependency graphs.

jamal (runtime): fine, single version. i'll add the edge bundling lint + smoke tests to the runtime pipeline this sprint.

alex (devex): thanks team. i'll update onboarding docs and examples to ESM-first, add a migration note for CJS, and paste the publish checklist into the release playbook. tagging follow-ups: @maria (pkg-leads) to finalize package.json template, @sasha (ts) to produce types publishing notes, @jamal (runtime) to add CI edge smoke tests.

maria (pkg-leads): sounds good — i'll open the publish-rfc PR with the exact package.json + publishing scripts. :thumbsup:
